title: Publicly Accessible Storage Bucket Attached
issue: S3 analytics dump bucket allows public unauthenticated read operations.
remediationAction: Enforce S3 Block Public Access and enable KMS customer-managed encryption.

title: Unrestricted SSH Port Open to Internet
issue: Security Group sg-0881a2 has inbound port 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediationAction: Restrict port 22 access to corporate VPN CIDR 10.150.0.0/16.

title: Outdated Operating System Kernel
issue: Amazon Linux 2 instance running unpatched kernel v5.4.180 with known privilege escalation risks.
remediationAction: Trigger SSM Patch Manager automated maintenance window.

title: Hardcoded AWS Access Keys in Workload Memory
issue: Long-lived IAM access keys detected in environment variables instead of IAM Role for EC2.
remediationAction: Revoke IAM user key pair and attach instance profile role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/AnalyticsMLRole.

title: Unencrypted EBS Root Volume
issue: Root EBS volume vol-08a1b2c3d is unencrypted.
remediationAction: Create snapshot, copy with KMS encryption enabled, and re-attach as root volume.

title: Orphaned Resource with Egress Traffic Anomalies
issue: Instance communicates with known suspicious IP space in Eastern Europe.
remediationAction: Isolate instance by applying quarantine security group sg-quarantine and terminate workload.

title: Missing Required Cost & Operational Tags
issue: Resource lacks Environment and CostCenter tags, violating corporate tagging policy.
remediationAction: Apply tags: Environment=Staging, CostCenter=CC-8821 via AWS Tag Editor.

title: IMDSv1 Enabled without Token Requirement
issue: Instance allows Instance Metadata Service v1 which is vulnerable to SSRF credential theft.
remediationAction: Require IMDSv2 by setting HttpTokens=required and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1.
